contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [?DN] IVL CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ GLOR IAEX ERCITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [?DN] IVL CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEX ERCITVS. In exergue: TRS. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.75gms, die axis: 6
